column3: “Prostitutions” is rendered “harlotry”; NASB supplies “have” before “children,” and renders “from after the LORD” as “forsaking the LORD.”
“Visit the bloods of Jezreel on the house of Jehu” is rendered “punish the house of Jehu for the bloodshed of Jezreel.”
“He said” is rendered “the LORD said.” The last clause, “that I will surely forgive them,” is rendered “that I should ever forgive them”; the meaning is uncertain.
“I will not be to you” is rendered “I am not your God”; NASB supplies “your God” and “the LORD.”
MT 2:1. “People of Israel” is rendered “sons of Israel,” and “children of the living God” “the sons of the living God”; NASB adds “You are.”
MT 2:2. “People of Judah … Israel” is rendered “sons of Judah … Israel,” and “one head” “one leader.”
